seriesTitle: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: It's the summer holidays, but teenager Pip is focused on her school research project investigating the case of 17-year-old Andie Bell, whose disappearance in 2019 has haunted the town of Little Kilton. Andie's boyfriend Sal Singh sent a text confessing to the murder before being found dead, seemingly taking his own life. Andie's body was never found. With her own secret connection to what happened five years ago, Pip is determined to prove Sal's innocence.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Now a team, Pip and Ravi turn their attention to Andie's best friends and find out Andie had a secret life that Sal was unhappy about. Meanwhile, Pip receives an anonymous warning.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Pip decides she must track down the drug dealer Max told her about, so against her better judgement, she seeks out a calamity party - an infamous secret teen party, full of drugs and sex. With the help of Cara and Lauren, Pip works out the next calamity party is the following weekend in the woods. Ravi is sceptical about Pip's plan, but she's determined to see it through and attend the party with Cara and Lauren.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Pip and Ravi find out more about Andie's secret life, and when Pip is presented with a new piece of evidence, she reaches a crisis point and questions whether Sal is guilty.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Pip discovers more than she bargained for and faces dark consequences when she tries to confront the killer. Just when it seems all is lost, the terrible truth is revealed.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Pip must come to terms with the repercussions of solving the case. But something isn't quite right, and Pip puts herself in danger once more to find out the whole truth.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Pip attempts to return to normal life and focus on her friends, school and Ravi. But when a key witness in Max Hastings's trial disappears, Pip feels the pull of a new case.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Pip hits a dead end and rethinks. Digging into Jamie's recent behaviour and last movements, she realises he may not be an innocent victim after all.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Pip's day in court proves harder than she imagined, while a promising lead about Jamie comes from an unlikely source.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Fresh evidence forces Pip back to her first line of inquiry with renewed urgency, while Max Hastings's testimony causes shock waves through the court.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: A daring night mission causes group tension and isolates Pip. Jamie's case stalls until Pip decodes a clue that cracks it wide open. In court, the verdict is given.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As they chase the truth, Pip and her friends face new risks and shocking discoveries. Will they find Jamie and make it through unharmed?
